title: Star Wars: Unlimited suspends Data Vault in Eternal
summary: Star Wars: Unlimited suspended the Data Vault base from Eternal on November 23, 2026; suspensions now last three sets, so it's out until Icons 2028 Edition.

facts: Data Vault (Jump to Lightspeed, card 24) is suspended from the Eternal format, effective immediately (announced November 23, 2026).
The base increases its player's minimum deck size by 10 cards.
Top Eternal decks already run 51 to 56 cards, and some Data Vault decks go up to 62, so the drawback wasn't costing enough.
Eternal suspensions now last three set releases instead of two, so Data Vault returns with Icons 2028 Edition.
The first two Eternal suspensions, War Juggernaut and IG-2000, Assassin's Aggressor, came back with Homeworlds.
details.why: Command/Vigilance Eternal decks lose a key base, and every future Eternal suspension will now last longer.

article: Star Wars: Unlimited has suspended Data Vault from the Eternal format, effective immediately. Game developer Aaron Miles announced the change in the Eternal Format Update: November 2026, posted on the official Star Wars: Unlimited site on November 23, 2026. Data Vault is a base from the Jump to Lightspeed set, card 24, and its text increases its player's minimum deck size by 10 cards.

According to the announcement, players have been reaching the top 8 of Eternal events with decks of 51, 52 and up to 56 cards, and some Data Vault players have gone as high as 62-card main decks. Miles writes that the format's redundancy of effects offsets the consistency players give up with a bigger deck, so Data Vault's in-game advantage does not come with an appropriately costed downside in Eternal. Command/Vigilance decks led by Anakin Skywalker, Grand Admiral Thrawn, Yoda and Emperor Palpatine are named among the format's top performers.

The update also changes how long Eternal suspensions last. Data Vault and all future suspensions will remain in effect for three set releases instead of two, so Data Vault stays suspended until the release of Icons 2028 Edition. The first two Eternal suspensions, War Juggernaut and IG-2000, Assassin's Aggressor, returned to the format with the release of Homeworlds.
Eternal players who built around Data Vault will need a different base for upcoming Planetary Qualifier and Regional Open events.

title: Pokémon China makes 30 pure gold Pikachu cards
summary: Pokémon China made 99.9% gold versions of all 30 Pikachu cards from 30th Celebration, on show in Shanghai from November 28 to December 27, 2026.

facts: Pokémon China made pure gold versions of all 30 Pikachu cards from the Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration.
Each card is 99.9% pure gold and weighs 30 grams, about 15 times a normal card's 2 grams.
The gold shows through on the borders, the Pikachu "30" logo borders and parts of the card back, under a printed layer.
They go on display at the Pokémon Card Art Illustration Exhibition, Lafayette Culture and Arts Center, Shanghai, November 28 to December 27, 2026.
They are exhibition pieces; no plans to sell them have been announced.
details.why: It's one of the most striking pieces of the Pokémon TCG's 30th anniversary, and a rare chance to see gold Pikachu cards in person.

article: Pokémon China has created pure gold versions of all 30 Pikachu cards from the Pokémon Trading Card Game's 30th Celebration, as part of the game's 30th anniversary. PokéBeach reported the reveal on November 23, 2026.

Each card is made of 99.9% pure gold and weighs 30 grams. A regular Pokémon card weighs about 2 grams, which makes each gold card roughly 15 times as heavy. The cards appear to be gold sheets with a printed layer over the top, so the gold shows through on the card borders, around the Pikachu "30" logos and on parts of the card back design.
All 30 cards will be displayed at a Pokémon Card Art Illustration Exhibition at the Lafayette Culture and Arts Center in Shanghai, China, from November 28 to December 27, 2026.
The gold cards are exhibition pieces, and no plans have been announced to sell them to the public, so the Shanghai exhibition is the way for fans to see them.
specs: Lafayette Culture and Arts Center, Shanghai

title: Pokémon's Aura Seeker reveals four secret rares
summary: Creatures revealed Blastoise, Hatterene and Hawlucha illustration rares and a Mega Lucario Z ex special illustration rare from Aura Seeker, out in Japan November 27, 2026.

facts: Creatures officially revealed three illustration rares and one special illustration rare from the Japanese set Aura Seeker (PokéBeach, November 22, 2026).
Illustration rares: #081 Blastoise (Nurikabe), #084 Hatterene (mashu) and #086 Hawlucha (GOSSAN).
Special illustration rare: #110 Mega Lucario Z ex, illustrated by REND.
Aura Seeker releases in Japan on November 27, 2026.
English players get these cards in Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists on February 6, 2027.
details.why: They're the first secret rares shown from the set behind Flowing Fists, so collectors get an early look at its chase cards.

article: Creatures has officially revealed four secret rare cards from Aura Seeker, the next Japanese expansion for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, according to a PokéBeach report on November 22, 2026. Aura Seeker releases in Japan on November 27, 2026.

The reveal includes three illustration rares and one special illustration rare. The illustration rares are Blastoise, card 081, illustrated by Nurikabe; Hatterene, card 084, illustrated by mashu; and Hawlucha, card 086, illustrated by GOSSAN.

The special illustration rare is card 110, Mega Lucario Z ex, illustrated by REND. Mega Lucario Z ex is the headline Pokémon of Aura Seeker, which is the first Japanese set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions, and these card numbers sit above the set's 78-card main set.

English-language players will receive the cards from Aura Seeker in Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists, which The Pokémon Company International has dated for February 6, 2027. That makes the Japanese reveals an early look at the secret rares collectors can expect to chase in the next English Pokémon TCG expansion.

title: Brazil's Vinícius Fernandez wins Pokémon TCG at LAIC
summary: Brazil's Vinícius Fernandez won the Pokémon TCG Masters title at the 2027 Latin America International Championships in São Paulo (Nov 20-22, 2026), topping 2,646 players.

facts: The 2027 Pokémon Latin America International Championships ran November 20-22, 2026 in São Paulo, Brazil, the first International Championships of the 2027 season.
Vinícius Fernandez of Brazil won the Pokémon TCG Masters division, which had 2,646 players; Damian Fernandez Urroz of Argentina finished second.
Owyn Kamerman (Netherlands) and Makani Tran (US) completed the Masters Top 4.
Lucas Tracy (US) won the Junior division and Oliver McNally (UK) the Senior division.
The event saw the debut of cards from Mega Evolution—Delta Reign; the next International is the Europe International Championships in London.
details.why: It's the first big result of the 2027 season and the first major tournament with Delta Reign cards, won by a Brazilian player at home.

article: Brazil's Vinícius Fernandez is the Pokémon Trading Card Game Masters champion of the 2027 Pokémon Latin America International Championships (LAIC). The event ran from November 20 to 22, 2026 in São Paulo, Brazil, and The Pokémon Company International published the final standings on Pokemon.com on November 22, 2026.

Fernandez topped a Masters division of 2,646 players. Damian Fernandez Urroz of Argentina finished second, with Owyn Kamerman of the Netherlands third and Makani Tran of the United States fourth. In the younger divisions, Lucas Tracy of the United States won the Junior title from a field of 229, and Oliver McNally of the United Kingdom won the Senior title from 310 players.

LAIC was the first International Championships of the 2027 tournament season and featured the debut of cards from the Mega Evolution—Delta Reign expansion in competitive play. The weekend also included Pokémon VGC, played in Pokémon Champions and won in Masters by Masahiro Taoka of Japan, and Pokémon GO, won by Aiden Hedderly of the United States.
The next stop on the Championship Series calendar is the Europe International Championships in London, England.

facts: Championship 26-27 Finals follow the Wave 1 and Wave 2 Area Qualifiers; the top four players advance to the Grand Finals, held this year in Tokyo, Japan.

article: Bandai has published the schedule and prizes for the Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World Championship 26-27 Finals, posted on the game's official site on November 20, 2026. After the Wave 1 and Wave 2 Area Qualifiers, top players compete in regional Finals, and the top four from each advance to the Grand Finals, which will be held in Tokyo, Japan.

The North America Finals run on January 9, 2027 at the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, Florida, during Bandai Card Games Fest 26-27 Orlando, organized by Play!TCG. The Latin America Finals (Santiago, Chile) and Oceania Finals (Marvel Stadium, Melbourne) both take place on January 16, 2027, and the Europe Finals run during BCG Fest London at ExCeL London. Registration is handled through the BANDAI TCG+ app.

Top 32 finishers receive an FB09-122 Gogeta alt-art card, Top 64 an ST01-068 Prince of Destruction alt-art and Top 128 an FB10-032 Son Goku alt-art, while the Top 8 also get an uncut sheet and every participant gets Energy Marker sets and Limited Packs.
Each Finals also runs 1-on-1 and 3-on-3 side events and a Last Chance Qualifier, whose Top 32 earn a Finals invite.

All 78 main-set cards are now revealed; it is Japan's seventh Mega Evolution set, starring Mega Lucario Z ex.
It is the first set with the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC: Mega Lucario Z ex, Mega Absol Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex, plus Mega Glimmora ex.
A special art rare of Crasher Wake's Fervor is drawn by manga artist Tetsuo Hara.
English players get the set's cards in Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists on February 6, 2027.
details.why: It's the first full look at the cards coming to the English Pokémon TCG in Flowing Fists early next year.

article: Aura Seeker, the next Japanese expansion for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, releases in Japan on Friday, November 27, 2026. The Pokémon Card Game's official Japanese site lists it as a MEGA expansion pack with five cards per pack, and PokéBeach reported on November 19, 2026 that all 78 main-set cards have now been officially revealed.

Mega Lucario Z ex stars in the set, which is Japan's seventh Mega Evolution expansion and the first to feature the Z Mega Evolutions introduced in the Mega Dimension DLC. Mega Absol Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex also appear, along with Mega Glimmora ex and other Pokémon ex such as Sceptile ex, Floatzel ex, Sigilyph ex and Togedemaru ex.

The official site highlights a special art rare (SAR) of the Supporter card Crasher Wake's Fervor illustrated by manga artist Tetsuo Hara. New Trainer cards in the main set include Korrina's Seriousness, Reporter, Bonding Sash and the Stadium Fight Arena.

English-language players will get the cards from Aura Seeker in Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists, which The Pokémon Company International has dated for February 6, 2027, so the Japanese release is an early look at the next English set.

title: Magic's Star Trek Commander Party runs Nov 20-26
summary: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Commander Party runs in WPN stores November 20-26, 2026 (again January 15-21, 2027), with Highly Illogical or Munitions Enthusiast promos.
source: Magic: The Gathering (official); Wizards Play Network

facts: Commander Party for Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek runs at WPN stores November 20-26, 2026, and again January 15-21, 2027.
It's a casual Commander event: on your turn you can tap a legendary creature to send an away team on a mission from the mission deck.
That creature becomes the mission specialist, and the mission's effects stay active until another player sends an away team; players without a legend can recruit an away team leader.
Each pod of three to four players gets a play aid, and stores receive mission cards and participation promos.
Players receive either a Munitions Enthusiast or Highly Illogical promo card (non-foil, traditional foil at WPN Premium stores), while supplies last.
details.why: It's a free-form, story-driven way to play the new Star Trek cards in Commander at your local store, with a promo for taking part.

article: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Commander Party runs at Wizards Play Network stores from November 20 to 26, 2026, with a second window from January 15 to 21, 2027. Wizards of the Coast describes Commander Party as a story-inspired Commander event set in the world of the latest release, with casual rules enforcement aimed at new players, lore fans and Commander regulars.

The Star Trek version adds away missions to a regular game of Commander. During their turn, a player can tap a legendary creature they control to send an away team on a mission: a card is turned over from the mission deck, that creature becomes the mission specialist, and the mission's first ability triggers. Its effects stay active for the table until another player sends an away team. Players without an eligible creature can recruit an away team leader.

Each pod of three to four players receives a play aid with a space for the party cards. Players who take part receive either a Munitions Enthusiast or Highly Illogical promo card; stores get non-foil copies by default and WPN Premium stores traditional foil copies, while supplies last.
Distribution of the promos varies by store, so Wizards advises players to check with their local WPN store for event times and details.

title: Disney Lorcana is going digital: every card, crossplay
summary: Ravensburger's first Disney Lorcana digital game dev blog (November 20, 2026) promises every card from every set, mobile and desktop crossplay and ranked play; no release date yet.

facts: Ravensburger posted the first developer blog for the Disney Lorcana TCG digital game on November 20, 2026; the game was first announced at D23 in August 2026.
The goal is to include every card from every set released: characters, songs, actions and locations.
It follows the same rules with the same cards as the tabletop game, so decks built digitally can be brought to the table.
One account works on mobile and desktop with crossplay, plus ranked matchmaking and replayable practice matches for new players.
There is no release date yet; fans can sign up at the Disney Lorcana site to hear first when testing begins.
details.why: Lorcana players will be able to test decks and new cards any time, with skills that carry over to game night.

article: Ravensburger has shared the first developer update for the digital version of the Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game. The Disney Lorcana Digital Game Dev Blog #1, posted on November 20, 2026 by executive producer Kyle Brink, sets out the team's goals for a version of the game playable on desktop and mobile. The digital game was first announced at D23 in August 2026.

The team's stated goal is to include every card from every Disney Lorcana set released, including characters, songs, actions and locations. Which visual variants will appear has not been decided. The digital game will follow the same rules with the same cards as the tabletop game, so a deck and playstyle developed digitally can be brought to the table on game night.

Players will use one account on mobile devices and PCs, with crossplay between them. The blog also describes a ranked play system with matchmaking, a replayable set of practice matches for new and returning players, and sounds, special effects and animations, along with privacy and safety features.
No release date or testing date has been announced. Ravensburger says future dev blogs will share progress, and fans can sign up on the Disney Lorcana website to be the first to learn more.
specs: Goal: every card from every set

A free Quest Booklet from the Creations Shop starts the Collection Quest; trade with other guests for four cards to earn the Minnie Mouse, Musical Artist promo.

The Ink & Find Scavenger Hunt rewards the Belle, Reflective Writer promo, and a Hyperia City Illumineer's Trove bought in the park comes with Alice, Tea Alchemist (limit 2 per guest, while supplies last).

details.why: It's a festival-only Figment card and three new Magical Places promos for Lorcana collectors visiting Walt Disney World early next year.

article: Ravensburger's Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game returns to the EPCOT International Festival of the Arts at the Walt Disney World Resort for a second year, running January 15 to March 1, 2027. Ravensburger and Disney detailed the festival's Lorcana activities and exclusive cards on November 19, 2026.

Three Magical Places promo cards are tied to activities in the park, and their art joins across all three cards. Guests pick up a free Quest Booklet at the Creations Shop and trade with other players to collect four Collection Quest cards, earning Minnie Mouse, Musical Artist. Finding every supersized card in the Ink & Find Scavenger Hunt earns Belle, Reflective Writer, and a Hyperia City Illumineer's Trove bought at select park locations comes with Alice, Tea Alchemist, limited to two per guest while supplies last.

The 2027 Festival Collection, a six-card set sold only at the festival, includes Mickey Mouse, Leader of the Band; Little John, Camp Cook; Powerline, Taking the Stage; Piglet, Cocoa Maker; Tiana, Diligent Waitress; and a glimmer of Figment, the EPCOT dragon, that is not available anywhere else. A premium foil Figment playmat and an art print are also planned.
Card artists will sign cards on select days, and the festival adds Lorcana chalk art, photo spots and a paint-by-numbers mural, making it a collecting trip for Lorcana fans.

summary: The Pokémon Company's Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists releases February 6, 2027 with over 110 cards, led by Mega Lucario Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex.

facts: Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists releases February 6, 2027, as part of the Mega Evolution Series.
The expansion includes over 110 cards, with artwork inspired by the excitement of a tournament atmosphere.
Mega Lucario Z ex leads the set, with Mega Absol Z ex, Mega Garchomp Z ex and Mega Glimmora ex also featured.
ICv2 counts 15 Pokémon and Trainer cards with special illustrations.
It comes in Elite Trainer Boxes, Build & Battle boxes, 3-booster blisters, booster displays and hanger packs (ICv2).
details.why: It's the next English Pokémon TCG expansion, with a new group of Mega Pokémon ex for players and collectors to chase.

article: The Pokémon Company International has announced Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists, the next English expansion for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The set releases on February 6, 2027, and includes more than 110 cards, according to an announcement on Pokemon.com on November 19, 2026. It is part of the Mega Evolution Series.

Mega Lucario Z ex headlines the expansion, joined by Mega Absol Z ex, Mega Garchomp Z ex and Mega Glimmora ex. The Pokémon Company describes the set's artwork as inspired by the excitement of a tournament atmosphere, and ICv2 reports 15 Pokémon and Trainer cards with special illustrations.

According to ICv2, Flowing Fists will be sold in Elite Trainer Boxes, Build & Battle boxes, 3-booster blister packs, booster displays and hanger booster packs. PokéBeach reports that prerelease events run from January 23 to January 31, 2027, that it is the first English set to release on a Saturday, and that it closely follows the Japanese set Aura Seeker, which releases in Japan on November 27, 2026.
The Pokémon Company says more details about the expansion are coming soon on Pokemon.com.
specs: Elite Trainer Box, Build & Battle box, 3-booster blister, booster display, hanger pack

title: Magic's Dune Secret Lair Superdrop lands November 30
summary: Secret Lair x Dune, My Arrakis, My Superdrop, launches November 30, 2026 with eight new-to-Magic Dune legends and a new Shai-Hulud card.

facts: My Arrakis, My Superdrop launches November 30, 2026, only on the Secret Lair store, with a pre-queue opening an hour before the 9 a.m. PT sale.
Secret Lair x Dune: Balance of Power has eight new-to-Magic legendary creatures, including Paul Atreides, Ducal Heir, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen and Princess Irulan Corrino.
Secret Lair x Dune: Deserts of Arrakis adds a new-to-Magic Shai-Hulud card, plus Crysknife, Thumper and Sandworm Incursion versions of existing cards.
Secret Lair x Dune: Spice is all halo foil, with Water of Life and Atreides and Harkonnen Spice Harvesters.
The new cards are legal in Commander, Legacy and Vintage; non-foil Balance of Power and Deserts of Arrakis come to WPN game stores at a later date.
details.why: It's Magic's biggest Dune crossover, adding brand-new legends that Commander players can build around.

article: Wizards of the Coast's Secret Lair x Dune Superdrop, My Arrakis, My Superdrop, launches on November 30, 2026, exclusively on the Secret Lair storefront. Wizards announced the drop on November 18, 2026, timing it ahead of the next installment of the Dune film trilogy.

The headline drop, Secret Lair x Dune: Balance of Power, contains eight new-to-Magic legendary creatures based on Dune's leading cast: Paul Atreides, Ducal Heir; Reverend Mother Jessica; Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV; Baron Vladimir Harkonnen; Chani, Blade of Sietch Tabr; Mohiam, Imperial Truthsayer; Muad'Dib, Prophet Foretold; and Princess Irulan Corrino. Secret Lair x Dune: Deserts of Arrakis adds a new-to-Magic Shai-Hulud card alongside Weathered Wayfarer and existing cards renamed as Sandworm Incursion, Crysknife and Thumper, plus a Wurm token.

The third drop, Secret Lair x Dune: Spice, is printed entirely in halo foil and includes Halo Fountain as Water of Life, Revel in Riches and two Spice Harvester cards. A Desert Power Everything Bundle combines the foil and non-foil editions of the first two drops. The new cards were designed by Studio X and are legal in Commander, Legacy and Vintage.
Non-foil editions of Balance of Power and Deserts of Arrakis will also reach WPN game stores at a later date, giving players a second way to pick up the new Dune legends.
specs: Three Secret Lair drops plus a Desert Power Everything Bundle

title: Magic's Nauctis drops Play Boosters for Booster Packs
summary: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm (February 5, 2027) sells 14-card Booster Packs, 30 per box, instead of Play Boosters, and Collector Boosters drop from 15 cards to 12.

facts: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm releases February 5, 2027 (MTG Arena February 2), with prereleases January 29 to February 4.
ICv2 reports Wizards has done away with Play Boosters for the set in favour of Booster Packs.
Each Booster Pack holds 14 cards plus a double-sided token, and a Booster Pack box holds 30 packs.
Collector Boosters now hold 12 cards instead of 15, with 12 Collector Boosters per box.
Both box types include a Sunken Treasures box topper, and about 1 in 1,000 Booster Packs and 1 in 300 Collector Boosters is a God Pack.
details.why: It changes what every Nauctis pack and box holds, for players drafting the set and collectors opening boxes.

article: Magic: The Gathering's next booster set, Nauctis: The Sunken Realm, changes how its packs are sold. The set releases on February 5, 2027, with prerelease events from January 29 to February 4 and an MTG Arena release on February 2. According to ICv2's November 16, 2026 report on the product line, Wizards of the Coast has done away with Play Boosters for Nauctis in favour of Booster Packs.

Each Nauctis Booster Pack contains 14 Magic cards and a double-sided token: six commons, a common or Special Guests card, three uncommons, a rare or mythic rare, an uncommon, rare or mythic rare slot, a slot that is either a common or a traditional foil rare or mythic rare and a basic land. A Booster Pack box holds 30 packs. Wizards lists the Booster Pack MSRP at $5.49.

Collector Boosters shrink from 15 cards to 12, with 12 Collector Boosters to a box at an MSRP of $26.99. Both box types include a Sunken Treasures box topper with one pearlescent card, and Nauctis is the first set with God Packs: about 1 in 1,000 Booster Packs and 1 in 300 Collector Boosters.

The rest of the line includes a Bundle with nine Booster Packs, a Secret Lair Bundle, Draft Night, four Commander decks with Premium Edition versions, and Prerelease Packs with six Booster Packs. Nauctis will be legal in all formats.
specs: 14 per Booster Pack; 12 per Collector Booster
30 Booster Packs or 12 Collector Boosters per box, plus a box topper

title: Riftbound's Convergence Fest hits Vegas Dec 11-13

facts: Convergence Fest brings Riftbound and Teamfight Tactics to the Las Vegas Convention Center, December 11-13, 2026.
Side event tickets go on sale November 18 at 8 AM PT, for anyone with a Convergence Fest Attendee, TFT Competitor or Riftbound Competitor pass; prizes come from a shared Prize Wall.
From December 9 to 15, participating US local game stores hand out an exclusive Ionic Spark battlefield promo, while supplies last; it is also available to Convergence Fest attendees.

article: Riot Games' Convergence Fest takes place at the Las Vegas Convention Center from December 11 to 13, 2026, bringing the Riftbound trading card game and Teamfight Tactics together for one weekend. Riot announced the side event schedule and after-party details on November 17, 2026, a day after revealing an exclusive store promo for players across the United States.

Side events for both games are open to anyone holding a Convergence Fest Attendee Pass, TFT Competitor Pass or Riftbound Competitor Pass. Tickets go on sale November 18 at 8 AM Pacific, and players earn Prize Wall tickets that can be redeemed for TFT and Riftbound goodies. The Encore, a DJ Sona after-party, follows on December 13 at Lot A outside AREA15.

For players who can't travel, participating local game stores in the United States will hand out an exclusive Ionic Spark Battlefield promo card between December 9 and December 15, while supplies last. Riot leaves the method to each store, suggesting demos, in-store events or Convergence Fest viewing parties, and says the promo should not be used as a purchase incentive. The same promo is available to attendees in Las Vegas.
For Riftbound collectors, the regional exclusive battlefield is the main reason to check with a local store before the promotional window opens.

details.why: Stamped League promos are a collectible reward just for playing at your local store, and the Mega Rayquaza playmat is the new League Cup trophy.

article: The Pokémon Company International is refreshing the prizes at Play! Pokémon Stores. Starting Tuesday, December 1, 2026, League Cups and League Challenges get a new playmat, acrylic standees and special stamped promo cards, according to an announcement on Pokemon.com on November 16, 2026.

Three Pokémon TCG promo cards carry the Play! Pokémon stamp. Participants in Friendly Tournaments can get Cinderace, League Challenge participants can get Lunatone, and League Cup participants can get the Mega Signal Trainer card. The promos are only available at select Play! Pokémon Stores, and players are told to check with their local store.

Mega Rayquaza headlines the League Cup prizes. Pokémon TCG winners can earn a playmat showing the key art from the Mega Evolution—Delta Reign expansion, with one playmat per top finisher in each age division. Top finishers in Pokémon VGC, and the overall top finisher in Pokémon GO, receive an acrylic Mega Rayquaza standee.

For players and collectors, stamped League promos are an easy way to add unique versions of cards to a collection just by taking part in local events, which are open to all ages and experience levels.

article: Star Wars: Unlimited Icons 2027 Edition releases on November 20, 2026. Fantasy Flight Games describes it as the first Icons set for the trading card game: a mini-set of more than 190 cards with a heavy focus on fan-favourite characters and straightforward mechanics.

facts: Stefan Schütz won Magic World Championship 32 at MagicCon: Atlanta, which ran November 13-15, 2026.

article: Stefan Schütz won Magic World Championship 32 at MagicCon: Atlanta, which ran November 13-15, 2026, taking the $100,000 first prize. The Team Handshake Moxfield player won the Standard Top 8 on Sunday, November 15 with Izzet Mission, a spell-heavy deck running four copies of Anthropological Mission alongside Ral, Crackling Wit and Into the Flood Maw.

Eduardo Sajgalik finished second and earned $50,000, with Kellen Pastore third and James Drake fourth, each earning $25,000. Along with the cash, Schütz receives invitations to every 2027 Pro Tour and the 2027 Limited Championship, a Black Lotus-themed trophy, and the chance to work with Magic's design team on a future card bearing his likeness and name.

The event was played in Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Draft and Standard, with the Top 8 in Standard. Star Trek released at tabletop on November 13, the day the event began. It was the final premier Standard event before rotation and capped the 2026 season.

World Championship 32 had a $1,000,000 prize pool, and every competitor took home at least $4,000. Before this win, Schütz's best Pro Tour-level result was fifth place at Pro Tour Secrets of Strixhaven.

article: Magic: The Gathering's Nauctis: The Sunken Realm releases on February 5, 2027, and is the first set with God Packs. It arrives on MTG Arena on February 2, with prerelease events from January 29 to February 4.

article: Netflix and Wizards of the Coast revealed PLANESWALKER, an animated series based on Magic: The Gathering, on November 13, 2026. The series premieres on Netflix in 2027.

The story centers on Chandra, a volatile pyromancer hunted for her gifts and haunted by her past. Facing an insidious force, Chandra and some of Magic's most legendary Planeswalkers must master their abilities, navigate treacherous alliances and battle their own inner demons to prevent a war that threatens thousands of worlds.

Terry Matalas is showrunner, with Cindy Appel as co-showrunner and Patrick Osborne as supervising director. Matalas, Appel and Osborne are executive producers, with Gabriel Marano executive producing and Lauren Chavez-Myers co-executive producing for Hasbro Entertainment. Daisy West is producer, and animation is by the studio Digic.
PLANESWALKER brings Magic's long-running story and characters to streaming, which could introduce the game's worlds to a large new audience. An exact premiere date has not been announced.

details.why: Riven, Kennen and Kai'Sa decks all lose key cards, so the competitive meta resets before December's North America Regional Championship.

article: Riftbound has added eight cards and two battlefields to its Standard and 2v2 Constructed ban list, effective Monday, November 23, 2026. Riot Games announced the Radiance ban list update on November 13, 2026.

The banned cards are Riven, Broken Blade; Zhonya's Hourglass; Stellacorn Herder; Nocturne, Horrifying; Rhasa the Sunderer; Brynhir Thundersong; Dazzling Aurora; and Baited Hook. The banned battlefields are Emperor's Dais and Star Spring.

Riven was the main target. The deck made up 43% of registered decks at the European Regional Championship, took 3 of the top 4 spots and 8 of the top 16, and posted a win rate of about 60% or higher against the field. Kennen, which won that event, loses Nocturne and Rhasa, and Kai'Sa loses Brynhir Thundersong. Dazzling Aurora was cut for packing too many dangerous effects into one card, and Baited Hook was banned early because upcoming cards, including those in Legacy, would combine dangerously with it.

The bans do not affect Korea and Traditional Chinese regions until Radiance releases there. The North America Regional Championship in Las Vegas follows on December 11-13. From 2027, Riftbound will announce bans in set windows: on the Friday two weeks before each Continental and the Friday two weeks after.

title: Magic's Star Trek is out; To Boldly Go league starts

facts: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek is in stores today, November 13, 2026.

Players start with six Star Trek Play Boosters and can add more boosters as they rank up.
Play three games at Starfleet Academy, then explore four quadrants (Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Delta), each with its own rules.

details.why: It's a casual, months-long way to play the new set at your local store, with a promo at the end.

article: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek is out in stores today, November 13, 2026, and Wizards Play Network stores are kicking off Magic Presents: To Boldly Go, a Sealed league that runs from November 13, 2026 through January 28, 2027.

Players start the league by buying six Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Play Boosters and receive a player insignia to track their progress. Play begins at Starfleet Academy, where players complete three games under special rules printed on the insignia. After graduating, they can play matches in any of four quadrants, Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Delta, each with its own themed rules, in any order and at their own pace.

Every three matches completed in a quadrant earns a rank pip sticker, and players can buy an additional booster at each promotion to grow their card pool. After 15 signatures, three from Starfleet Academy plus three from each quadrant, a player reaches the rank of Captain and earns the exclusive Magic Presents: To Boldly Go promo card.
The league is casual, run at Casual Rules Enforcement Level, and Wizards suggests stores run it over six to eight weeks. Ask your local store whether it is taking part.
specs: To Boldly Go promo card at rank of Captain

title: My Little Pony TCG's The Coronation lands Feb 19

title: Flesh and Blood's 2027 season: three $200K Pro Tours
summary: The 2027 World Tour brings three $200,000 Pro Tours, one Global Leaderboard and a $10,000 Player of the Year crowned in Kobe; Pro Quests start February 13, 2027.
article: Legend Story Studios has outlined the 2027 Flesh and Blood World Tour, which will feature three Pro Tours with $200,000 USD prize pools each: Pro Tour London on February 25-28, Pro Tour Copenhagen on June 17-20 and Pro Tour Minneapolis on October 7-10, 2027. The 2027 World Championship takes place in Kobe, Japan, on December 2-5, 2027.

Regional leaderboards are going away. In 2027 there will be a single Global Leaderboard and one World Tour Player of the Year, crowned in Kobe with a trophy and a $10,000 USD cash prize. Money from the old regional prizes moves into events, with Showdowns rising to $10,000 and Callings to $30,000.

Pro Tour qualification now comes from winning a Pro Quest, a Top 32 finish at the previous Pro Tour, a Top 100 spot on the World Tour Leaderboard or redeeming a Professional Tournament Invitation. Pro Quest: Copenhagen runs February 13-21, 2027, in Limited and March 6-14 in Classic Constructed.

From December 6, 2027, PTIs become Pro Tour Invitations and can no longer be used for National Championships or Worlds. The 2027 program year runs from November 7, 2026, to December 5, 2027, after which seasons follow the calendar year.

article: Nicolas Jamoulle of Canada is the 2026 Flesh and Blood World Champion after winning World Championship: Paris on Fang, Dracai of Blades. article: Konami's Magnificent Maestros, a 125-card Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG set, launches on November 13, 2026, with an MSRP of $34.99. Official Tournament Stores get it two days early on November 11, and the cards are tournament legal from November 13.

title: Gundam's "Claim Miorine" 3-on-3 battles start Dec 4
summary: Teams of three battle at participating stores December 4-31, 2026 and January 8-28, 2027; the winning team gets a foil "Mutual Attraction" promo.
article: Bandai's Gundam Card Game is running "CLAIM MIORINE" 3 on 3 Battle, a team event at participating stores, in two waves: December 4-31, 2026 and January 8-28, 2027.

Players enter as a team of three with a team name and a representative. Each round is three 1-on-1 matches played at the same time on three tables, with seats A, B and C facing each other, and a team wins the round when two of its three players win. Seating order is fixed at check-in, and teams without three members cannot take part. At full capacity a store hosts 8 teams, or 24 players, playing Swiss rounds, with a single-elimination playoff if teams are tied for the most wins.

All participants receive the GD05-106 Mutual Attraction participation card after the event. The three members of the winning team, plus three players picked in a lucky draw, receive a special foil version.

Registration is handled at the participating store by the team representative, with all three players checking in on the day through the BANDAI TCG+ app. The official store list is marked tentative, so players should check with their local store for registration dates.
specs: Teams of 3, three 1-on-1 matches per round

title: Riftbound's T1 Worlds Champion bundle goes to a drawing
summary: The T1 Player Bundle, with Champion cards picked by Faker and team, joins the Worlds 2026 Edition in one online drawing, open November 13-16.
article: Riot Games is selling the Riftbound T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle and the Riftbound x Worlds 2026 Edition through a single online drawing on the Riot Games Merch store. Registration opens November 13 at 9:00 a.m. PT and closes November 16 at 9:00 a.m. PT, with the first emails to selected entrants going out on November 17.

The T1 Player Bundle ($70 plus shipping) honours the 2025 world champions with five Champion cards chosen by Doran, Oner, Faker, Gumayusi and Keria: Ambessa The Wolf, Xin Zhao The Vigilant, Galio Indefatigable, Miss Fortune Buccaneer and Seraphine Not Alone. They are the same cards as the T1 2025 Worlds Champion Signature Edition with different alt arts, and use T1 Worlds 2025 skin splash art. The bundle adds a deck box, card binder, sleeves and a D12 die, with a chance of a rare gold die. It comes in English, Chinese and Korean.

The Worlds 2026 Edition ($80 plus shipping, English only) holds an alt-art Unforgiven (Yasuo) Legend promo, three Battlefield promos showing Los Angeles, Allen and New York City, a deck box and foil sleeves.

Selected entrants get 24 hours to buy, and online orders begin shipping in mid-December. Both products are also sold on site at Worlds events in Allen, Texas, and New York City through November, while supplies last.

title: Pokémon TCG joins the National Toy Hall of Fame
summary: The Pokémon Trading Card Game joined the National Toy Hall of Fame's class of 2026, announced November 5, alongside Bingo, Care Bears and the playground slide.
article: The Pokémon Trading Card Game has been inducted into the National Toy Hall of Fame as part of the class of 2026. The inductees were announced on November 5, 2026, by the Hall of Fame's home, The Strong National Museum of Play in Rochester, New York.

Pokémon cards joined three other inductees: Bingo, Care Bears and the playground slide. That makes four inductees this year instead of the usual three. The remaining eight finalists, Bop It!, Mahjong, Monster High dolls, Mouse Trap, Polly Pocket, Sorry!, Tickle Me Elmo and Yahtzee, were not selected.

Curator Mirek Stolee said the game's widespread appeal and global presence are undeniable, and that it successfully adapted card game formulas established by its predecessors, making the hobby more accessible. Associated Press coverage noted that the selection was helped along by anime fans and manga readers.

The honour comes during what ICv2 calls a historic sales run for the Pokémon TCG that began in 2024. It also places a trading card game among the classic toys and games recognised by the Hall of Fame, a nod to how widely the hobby is now played and collected.
specs: National Toy Hall of Fame, class of 2026
The Strong National Museum of Play, Rochester, NY
Bingo, Care Bears, the playground slide

title: Flesh and Blood dates One Lotus and Ancients Awaken
summary: The Paris keynote lists One Lotus for Q2 2027 (premiere May 21-23, Singapore) and Ancients Awaken for Q3 (Sept 10-12, Antwerp).
article: Legend Story Studios used its Flesh and Blood keynote at the World Championship in Paris to date its next booster sets for 2027. One Lotus is listed for Q2 2027, with a World Premiere in Singapore on May 21-23, 2027. Ancients Awaken follows in Q3 2027, with its World Premiere in Antwerp on September 10-12, 2027.
Before both, Outbreak gets its World Premiere in Philadelphia on January 29-31, 2027. Card counts, prices and full release dates for One Lotus and Ancients Awaken have not been announced.

The keynote also laid out the 2027 World Tour. The 2027 World Championship heads to Kobe on December 2-5, 2027. Pro Tours are set for London (February 25-28), Copenhagen (June 17-20) and Minneapolis (October 7-10). Callings are scheduled for Shibuya, Toulouse, Los Angeles, Beijing, São Paulo, Sydney and Warsaw, and the United States National Championship is in Detroit on April 23-25, 2027.
For players, the schedule gives a clear picture of when new sets will shake up the competitive formats next year and where the biggest events will be held.
specs: One Lotus Q2 2027; Ancients Awaken Q3 2027

title: Riftbound: The Reckoning hits preorder
summary: The 250-card booster set, with over 60 Showcase cards, reaches retail April 30, 2027, alongside The Vault bundle and Shyvana and Vayne Champion Decks.
article: Riftbound: League of Legends Trading Card Game's next booster set, The Reckoning, is now on preorder and reaches retail on April 30, 2027, according to ICv2. The set is published by UVS Games and Riot Games and was first teased at Gen Con 2026.

The Reckoning is a 250-card set with more than 60 Showcase cards. Each booster contains 14 cards. The set focuses on larger, heavier champions, including Aurelion Sol, Cho'Gath, Shyvana, Vayne and Zilean.

The product line has four main SKUs. Boosters come in booster displays and in The Vault bundle, which contains 6 packs, 36 Runes and 3 full-art tokens. Two Champion Decks, Shyvana and Vayne, each include a preconstructed deck, a booster pack, a paper playmat and a custom card box, and ship in displays of four.

Pricing has not been announced. For players, the Champion Decks offer a ready-made way into the new champions, while the 60-plus Showcase cards give collectors a large chase list when the set lands next spring.
specs: Boosters, The Vault bundle, Shyvana and Vayne Champion Decks

title: Star Wars: Unlimited Gift Box lands November 20
summary: Fantasy Flight's Gift Box hits retail November 20, 2026, with 8 boosters and 3 exclusive promos: Moff Gideon, General Veers and Icons 2027 Chewbacca.
article: Fantasy Flight Games will release the Star Wars: Unlimited Gift Box at retail on November 20, 2026, with an MSRP of $29.99. The box contains eight booster packs and three promo cards that are exclusive to this product.

The boosters span several sets: one pack each of Secrets of Power, A Lawless Time, Ashes of the Empire and Homeworlds, plus four packs from Star Wars: Unlimited Icons 2027 Edition. The three exclusive promos are the Moff Gideon unit, the General Veers unit and Chewbacca, all from Icons 2027 Edition.

The product is listed on the Asmodee store as Star Wars: Unlimited - 2026 Giftbox, SKU SWHA029EN, and was already shown as sold out there at the time of checking. Players looking for one may need to check local game stores and other retailers.

Gift boxes like this one are aimed at the holiday season, offering a mix of older and upcoming boosters along with promos that cannot be pulled from regular packs, which makes the box a way to sample Icons 2027 Edition ahead of time.

title: Lorcana bans My Adventure Book from Core Constructed
summary: The ban took effect November 3, 2026; Ravensburger says the card gave decks with few or no characters too much consistency.
article: Ravensburger has banned My Adventure Book from the Disney Lorcana TCG's Core Constructed format, effective Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The item card comes from Attack of the Vine!, released in July 2026. Core Constructed tournaments and competitive events at Ravensburger Game Hub stores no longer accept deck lists that include it.

In the announcement, Play Design Manager Alyson Erb said My Adventure Book gave too much consistency to decks that play very few or no characters, relying almost entirely on items and actions. The team said those decks led to frustrating, repetitive or uninteractive games and drifted away from the character-focused play at the heart of the game. It noted such decks were not always the strongest, but their play patterns hurt the experience.

The same update also banned Bend to My Will in [Format Coconut], the multiplayer format currently in beta testing. Lead Game Designer Lukas Litzsinger said the card grinds multiplayer games to a halt.

The Disney Lorcana ban list as of November 3 is now My Adventure Book in Core Constructed, Hiram Flaversham - Toymaker in Infinity Constructed, and Bend to My Will in [Format Coconut]. Players running item-heavy, low-character decks will need to rebuild before their next Core Constructed event.
specs: My Adventure Book (Attack of the Vine!)
Bend to My Will in [Format Coconut]

title: Lorcana D23 Collection winners get emails today
summary: Winners of the online draw for the 2026 D23 Collection and Hunny Wizard playmat get emails starting November 18 (moved from November 4); orders arrive within 2-3 weeks.
article: Ravensburger is notifying the winners of its online drawing for the 2026 Disney Lorcana D23 Collection and the Winnie the Pooh – Hunny Wizard Premium Foil Playmat, two products first sold at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in August 2026. According to the official Disney Lorcana announcement, winners begin receiving email notifications on November 18, 2026.

Entries were open from Saturday, October 31, 2026 at 9 a.m. ET to Sunday, November 1, 2026 at 9 p.m. ET. The sale runs through EQL, a third-party launch platform: fans signed up for an EQL account and provided credit card details to verify their identity, and a random selection then decided who can buy. Ravensburger says EQL tracks past launches and gives priority to fans who missed out on earlier offerings.

The products ship only to the United States, the United Kingdom and the European Union, and are not eligible to ship to Mexico, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or other territories. Because of high order volume, Ravensburger asks winners to allow two to three weeks for order communication and a tracking number.
Quantities are limited, and Ravensburger says the playmat will not be restocked once stock runs out. Fans who were not selected will not get another chance once stock is depleted.
specs: United States, United Kingdom, European Union

title: Pokémon Happy Meals return to McDonald's November 10
summary: Participating US McDonald's restaurants bring back Pokémon Happy Meals on November 10, 2026, with 15 mini box toys and 15 collectible cards.
article: Pokémon Happy Meals return to participating McDonald's restaurants across the United States on November 10, 2026. The promotion includes two separate collections: 15 collectible toys and 15 Pokémon trading cards.

According to McDonald's, the toys are mini Happy Meal box shapes that transform into bag charms. Characters named in coverage include Pikachu, Eevee, Charmander, Squirtle and Umbreon, and cards shown so far include Jirachi, Pikachu and Absol. A QR code on the Happy Meal box leads to an online game in which players search for all 15 toys hidden in a virtual classroom and playground.

The United States is one of several markets getting the promotion in November 2026, alongside Australia, Canada, Fiji, France, New Zealand and Spain. Around 40 more countries, including Germany, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia and Singapore, follow in December, about 24 more such as Brazil, Italy, Mexico and the Philippines in January 2027, and Ireland and the UK in February 2027. Exact dates outside the US have not been announced.

McDonald's has not announced an end date for the US promotion or how long supplies of each toy and card will last. Since the toys and the cards are two separate collections of 15 each, completing both sets will take several visits.
specs: Mini Happy Meal boxes that become bag charms

title: Magic's Star Trek reaches MTG Arena November 10
summary: Star Trek launches on MTG Arena November 10, with an early access event streaming Wednesday, November 4, on YouTube and Twitch.
article: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek launches on MTG Arena on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, three days ahead of the set's tabletop release on November 13. Before that, Wizards of the Coast is hosting an early-access event on Wednesday, November 4, starting at 10 a.m. PT, where Magic and MTG Arena players and personalities take the set for a first run, streamed on YouTube and Twitch.

Three preorder bundles are on sale at $49.99 each. The Pack Bundle includes 45 Star Trek packs, 5 mythic packs, 5 Golden packs and a Captain James T. Kirk card; the Pass Bundle includes the Set Mastery Pass with 10 bonus levels and a Captain Jean-Luc Picard card; the Play Bundle includes 4 Draft tokens, 2 Sealed tokens and a Captain Kathryn Janeway card.

The free Set Mastery track offers up to 36 Star Trek packs and 5 Mastery Orbs. Premier Draft, Pick-Two Draft and Traditional Draft for the set run from November 10 to February 2, and Sealed runs November 10 to December 8.
The November Arena Championship qualifiers also use Star Trek Sealed, with Play-Ins on November 14 and 20 and the Qualifier Weekend on November 21-22.

title: Delta Reign hits stores Friday, Mega Rayquaza returns
summary: Mega Evolution: Delta Reign releases November 6, 2026, bringing Mega Rayquaza back for the first time in over a decade.
article: Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign, the next expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game's Mega Evolution Series, releases on November 6, 2026. The set brings Mega Rayquaza back to the game as Mega Rayquaza ex, the first time Mega Rayquaza has appeared since the XY—Ancient Origins expansion.

Mega Rayquaza ex is joined by Mega Golurk ex, Mega Malamar ex and Mega Golisopod ex. Delta Reign also introduces Legendary Stadium cards: two Stadium cards played together as a pair, forming one extended artwork. Booster packs that contain a Legendary Stadium include both halves. The set has over 135 cards, including 14 illustration rare Pokémon, 17 ultra rare Pokémon and Trainer cards, and 6 special illustration rare Pokémon and Supporter cards.

Products include 10-card booster packs (MSRP $4.49), an Elite Trainer Box ($49.99) with nine boosters and a full-art foil Kyogre promo, a 6-pack Booster Bundle ($26.94), booster displays and a Build & Battle Box ($21.99). Prerelease events at select Play! Pokémon stores began October 24, 2026, using Build & Battle Boxes with one of four foil promos: Masquerain, Magmortar, Enamorus or Kommo-o.

Demand has been high: the Pokémon Center's first preorder wave of Delta Reign booster displays, Elite Trainer Boxes and Booster Bundles sold out quickly, a sign of strong interest in the set's return of Mega Rayquaza.

title: Magic's Star Trek prerelease starts November 6
summary: Prerelease Packs hold six Play Boosters, a foil promo, a deck box and a spindown die; the set releases November 13, 2026.
article: Prerelease events for Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek begin at local game stores on November 6, 2026, one week before the set's tabletop release on November 13, 2026. Wizards of the Coast lists prerelease events running from November 6 to November 12, while the digital version arrives on MTG Arena on November 10.

Each Star Trek Prerelease Pack contains six Play Boosters, a traditional foil rare or mythic rare promo card and a Spindown life counter die, and Wizards' prerelease guide also lists a deck box. Each Play Booster holds 14 Magic cards. Players build a 40-card sealed deck from their pack plus any number of basic lands, and the official guide suggests about 17 lands, at least five removal spells and a curve weighted toward two- and three-mana cards.

The set has ten two-color draft archetypes, each with two multicolor uncommon signpost cards, and Wizards notes that Star Trek contains more threatening artifacts than usual, so artifact removal is worth prioritizing. Prerelease Packs are available in English, French, German, Italian, Japanese and Spanish.
Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek is a Universes Beyond set drawing on 60 years of Star Trek history. Play Boosters carry an MSRP of $6.99, and the main set is legal in all formats once it releases.
specs: Spindown die; deck box per Wizards' guide

title: Flesh and Blood Worlds hits Paris this week
summary: The World Championship runs November 5-8 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, with more than $300,000 in cash prizes, live on YouTube from November 6.
article: The 2026 Flesh and Blood World Championship takes place November 5-8, 2026 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles in Paris, France, in Pavillon 5. Legend Story Studios has put $300,000 in cash prizes on the line, with $100,000 going to the new World Champion.

The invitation-only main event is played in Classic Constructed and Booster Draft. Player registration and the Legend Story Studios keynote presentation (7:30 PM local time) are on Thursday, November 5. The competition starts on Friday, November 6 with Rounds 1-8, continues with Rounds 9-15 on Saturday, and finishes with a Classic Constructed Top 8 on Sunday, November 8.

Prizes go deep: second place earns $25,000, third and fourth $16,500 each, and the Top 32 all receive Professional Tournament Invitations. The Top 8 receive Gold Foil prize cards and the winner gets a World Champion prize card.

Open-entry players have plenty to do as well. A Classic Constructed Calling with a $100,000 prize pool runs November 7-8, and a Silver Age Showdown worth $5,000 is held on Sunday, November 8. All three days of the World Championship stream live on the official Flesh and Blood YouTube channel, starting at 9:00 AM local time on Friday.
specs: Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, Paris
Flesh and Blood YouTube, from November 6

title: Flesh and Blood moves Wager to the damage step
summary: The October 30 rules update, effective now, moves Wager before go again, restoring Zane's Celebrant Broadsword combo, and errata's Trained Saurian.

facts: Legend Story Studios' October 30, 2026 rules update, released with Smash Palace: Chorus of Steel, changes when wagers are decided.
A wager is now settled at the beginning of the damage step, before go again gives the action point; it used to be settled in the resolution step.
The fix restores Zane, Broadly Beloved's combo with Celebrant Broadsword: win a wager, the crowd cheers, and the attack gets go again in time to use it.
It also lines up wager timing with on-hit and on-damage effects.
Trained Saurian gets errata: it now also attacks when it enters the arena, not only at the start of your action phase.
details.why: Warrior players get their wager payoffs in time to keep attacking, which makes Zane's sword plan work as printed.

title: Pokémon's Valentine's Box arrives January 15
summary: The Pokémon Company's Valentine's Box hits retail January 15, 2027, with 20 booster packs, To/From labels and a Valentine mailbox.

facts: The Pokémon TCG Valentine's Box releases January 15, 2027, at $14.99 MSRP.
It's the first Valentine's Day product in the Pokémon TCG's history.
Inside are 20 Collect & Share mini booster packs of three cards each, plus two sheets of To/From labels.
The box turns into a mailbox for valentines, with three sheets of stickers to decorate it.
It works like the Halloween Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle; the card list has not been revealed yet.
details.why: It's a low-cost way to hand out cards at school or among friends on Valentine's Day.

title: Gundam Card Game heads to PAX Unplugged
summary: Learn to Play demo decks and Event Sealed Battles at PAX Unplugged in Philadelphia, December 4-6, 2026.

facts: The Gundam Card Game will be at PAX Unplugged at the Pennsylvania Convention Center in Philadelphia, December 4-6, 2026 (Expo Hall 2243, Game Hall GH31A).
Learn to Play sessions give out a random demo deck while supplies last.
Sealed Battles take 32 players twice a day; you buy 4 booster packs at the tournament area to enter.
Every Sealed Battle player gets a Store Tournament Participation Prize 2026 Vol.4 promo (one of 8 cards), with a separate winner's prize.
Merchandise includes Special Booster Bundle 01, a storage box and resource card set, and EX02 matte sleeves; all activities need PAX entry.
details.why: It's an easy way for East Coast players to try the game and pick up this season's tournament promos.

title: Mega Rayquaza ex gets a Premium Tournament Collection
summary: The Pokémon Company's Mega Rayquaza ex box releases February 12, 2027, with four foil promos, eight booster packs and Dragon Shield sleeves.

facts: The Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection releases February 12, 2027, at $49.99 MSRP.
Its promo is the full-art Mega Rayquaza ex that was left out of Delta Reign, plus foil Zinnia's Trust, Adventure Lantern and Mega Rayquaza Cap, and a two-card Legendary Summit Stadium.
It includes eight booster packs, a coin and a Pokémon TCG Live code card.
The 65 sleeves and deck box are made by Dragon Shield, the first Pokémon TCG product with Dragon Shield accessories.
The previous box in the line, Lillie's, cost $39.99 with six packs in April 2025.
details.why: It's the only way so far to get the missing full-art Mega Rayquaza ex in English.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh!'s Maze of Machines lands March 2027
summary: Konami's 153-card booster set releases March 19, 2027, with Rampant Barrel Dragon, Slot Machine 777 and 10 new Yu-Gi-Oh! GX cards.

facts: Konami's Maze of Machines booster set releases in North America on March 19, 2027 (March 18 in Europe).
The set has 153 cards, 7 per pack, and centers on DARK Machines like Rampant Barrel Dragon.
Cubic, Marincess and Ghostrick get new support, plus 10 new Yu-Gi-Oh! GX cards tied to the Tag Force GX game.
Seven existing cards get Extended Art versions, including Summoned Skull with new art, and there are chibi variants for collectors.
Booster displays retail for $107.76.
details.why: It's the next set in the Maze line, mixing nostalgic anime support with reprints of in-demand cards.

title: Goldin's Pokémon 30th auction passes $28 million
summary: Goldin's October 25 auction had 18 record sales, led by a PSA 10 Art Academy Mudkip promo at $4.88 million and a Trophy Pikachu over $3 million.

facts: Goldin's 2026 Pokémon 30th Anniversary auction closed October 25 with more than $28 million in sales and 18 record prices.
A PSA 10 2015 Japanese XY Promo Art Academy Daisuke Ochiai Mudkip sold for $4.88 million.
A PSA 8 1997 Japanese Gold 1st Place Trophy Pikachu, the only copy in the PSA census, sold for over $3 million (both prices include buyer's premium).
PSA 10 Art Academy Sableye and Gourgeist cards sold for $976,000 each.
A factory-sealed 2005 EX Team Rocket Returns booster box sold for $384,300.
details.why: Two seven-figure cards in one sale shows the top of the vintage and promo market is still climbing in the 30th anniversary year.

title: Star Trek gets a Secret Lair Superdrop
summary: "Set Phasers to Superdrop" brings five Star Trek-themed Secret Lair drops, with direct preorders opening November 9.

facts: Secret Lair: Set Phasers to Superdrop goes on sale November 9, 2026, at 9 a.m. PT on MagicSecretLair.com, with a pre-queue from 8 a.m. PT.
Five drops are revealed so far: New Worlds (10 full-art basic lands), Beam Me Up, tlhIngan maH, KHAAAAAAAAN and Lower Decks; a sixth comes later.
Each drop costs $29.99 non-foil or $39.99 foil.
The cards mix reprints and new art across Star Trek, from The Original Series to Lower Decks, and many are reversible.
The sale is four days before Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek reaches stores on November 13.
details.why: Secret Lairs are print-to-order for a short window, so fans who want these Star Trek versions need to buy during the sale.

title: Dual Fusion is out in TCG Pocket
summary: The expansion launched October 28, debuting dual-type cards led by Mega Mewtwo X ex and Mega Greninja ex.

facts: Dual Fusion, the first expansion of Pokémon TCG Pocket's new C Series, went live on October 28 at 6 p.m. PDT (October 29, 01:00 UTC).
It debuts dual-type cards, including Mega Mewtwo X ex (Psychic and Fighting) and Mega Greninja ex (Water and Darkness).
There are two packs, Pikachu and Mega Mewtwo X, and Pikachu, Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise get new cards and art.
Six Dual Fusion rental decks are available until December 15, 2026, and Special Pack: First Partners starts October 31.
It lands just before the app's second anniversary (it launched October 30, 2024); new main sets now come about every six weeks instead of four.
details.why: Dual types change deckbuilding in TCG Pocket, since one card can now count for two types.

title: Reality Fracture bundle delayed
summary: The Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed by shipping and production issues, after the Star Trek Commander Decks slipped first.

facts: Wizards of the Coast said on October 20 that the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed globally due to production and shipping issues.
It may arrive shortly after the set's October 23 release date, with exact timing varying by region.
It follows Wizards' earlier delay of the Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Commander decks.
Several other Reality Fracture products, including Collector Boosters and bundles, had already been delayed in some regions since September.
details.why: Stores and preorder customers should expect the Secret Lair Bundle a little late; check with your store before release weekend.

title: Into the Inkdark opens for preorder
summary: Disney Lorcana's next set is expected February 12, 2027, with the first serialized Illustrious cards.

facts: Ravensburger has opened preorders for Into the Inkdark, with release expected February 12, 2027.
It is the first Disney Lorcana set with serialized Illustrious cards.
Collector Boosters, 12-card premium packs, will be sold at select Ravensburger Play Hub stores, Disney Parks and Disney stores.
The product line includes an Illumineer's Trove, Prerelease Kits and Booster Displays, plus new Jack-Jack Parr and Snow White playmats.
details.why: Serialized cards and Collector Boosters are new territory for Lorcana, so this set could become a big chase for collectors.

title: Chorus of Steel lands October 30
summary: Smash Palace brings back Ultimate Pit Fight multiplayer with two new heroes, Zane and Killjoy.

facts: Smash Palace: Chorus of Steel reaches local game stores on October 30, 2026 (set code SPW, 31 cards, English only).
It's a ready-to-play multiplayer box set that pits Warrior heroes against each other to become Master of the Blade.
Inside: 12 Mastery Pack Warrior boosters, a 40-card Event Deck, two rainbow foil heroes and two weapons, and two two-player game arenas.
The heroes are Zane, Broadly Beloved and Killjoy, the Crooked Blade, a Revered and a Reviled Warrior that are also legal in Silver Age.
To play: crack 3 packs, remove the last 3 cards from each, shuffle the rest, pick a hero and play; there are enough packs for four players.
details.why: It follows last year's Guardian Smash Palace and gives casual groups a no-deckbuilding way into Flesh and Blood multiplayer.

title: Doug Ferguson's collection heads to auction
summary: Items from the collection go up for auction on November 3, led by a jumbo graded card of Doug himself.

facts: Landry Pop Auctions is selling items from the Pokémon collection of Doug Ferguson, with the auction on November 3, 2026, and prebidding open.
Ferguson was Senior Vice President of Product Development at Pokémon and retired in 2019 after more than 16 years, after over 6 years at Wizards of the Coast.
He is one of the few people with their own Pokémon TCG card.
The top lot is a CGC-graded 2019 Black Star Promo TPCi01 Doug Ferguson GX farewell gift, an 18" x 25" jumbo card; only five oversized copies were made.
More than 50 other lots range from magazines and CoroCoro comics to video games.
details.why: It's a rare chance to buy items straight from a former Pokémon TCG executive's own collection, including a card made in just five copies.

title: Dracule Mihawk OP14-020 is banned
summary: The leader card is banned, alternate arts included, and the ban is now in effect.

facts: Bandai banned the Leader OP14-020 Dracule Mihawk from OP-14 The Azure Sea's Seven, effective October 12, 2026.
The ban was announced on September 24 and includes parallel (alt-art) printings; the card cannot be included in any deck.
Bandai plans to hand out a replacement Leader, P-163 Dracule Mihawk with new text, at future events.
The banned list now has six cards (Pudding, Nami, Moria, Law, Reject and Mihawk) plus three banned pairs, with no restricted cards.
details.why: Anyone on a Mihawk OP14-020 deck needs a new Leader for official play, and the alt art lost much of its value after the news.

title: Deck Crafter's Collection is out now
summary: A box packed with competitive staples; Lorcana's Collection Quests also head to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.

facts: The Pokémon TCG Deck Crafter's Collection (2026) released October 23, 2026, at $9.99 MSRP.
It holds a foil Meowth ex reprint from Perfect Order, whose Ability searches your deck for a Supporter card, plus 39 tournament-ready Trainer cards.
Staples include 4 Boss's Orders, 4 Lillie's Determination, 2 Dawn, 2 Hilda and 2 Judge.
Also inside: a Pitch Black booster pack, a Deck Crafter's Guide, 9 labeled dividers and a Pokémon TCG Live code card.
Separately, Ravensburger confirmed Disney Lorcana Collection Quests are coming to the Disney Cruise Line fleet in 2027.
details.why: It's a cheap way to pick up a full set of competitive Trainer staples, a lower-priced follow-up to the old Trainer's Toolkits.

title: UK collection sells for over $2 million
summary: A UK collector sold Pokémon cards for over $2 million, reportedly a UK record.

facts: A single-owner Pokémon collection sold for £1.56 million including buyer's premium (about $2.1 million) at Ewbank's in Send, Surrey, on October 21, 2026.
The seller, an anonymous retired decorator from Woking, had kept 41 master sets in his attic for about 15 years after his son lost interest.
The pre-sale estimate was £250,000 to £270,000; the top lot, a Legendary Collection master set with a near-mint Charizard, was estimated at £15,000 to £20,000 and made £100,000.
Ewbank's called it the UK's most valuable trading card auction ever, beating the £872,000 Stanley Gibbons sale in London on October 9.
The owner only sought a valuation after reading that a single Pokémon card had sold for more than £6,000.
details.why: Raw, complete binders beat graded slabs here: completeness and condition alone pushed this sale to six times its estimate.

title: Face Scan Check-in
summary: Bandai's BANDAI TCG+ app in Asia now uses face registration for some events, to stop multiple accounts and proxy entries.

facts: Bandai began face data registration in the Asia-region BANDAI TCG+ app on July 2, 2026.
Registration is needed to enter or take part in certain events.
Bandai says it's meant to enforce TCG+ rules against multiple accounts and proxy entries.
In Japan, Bandai said in August that it is considering ID checks with the My Number card.
The English-language TCG+ app asked all users to register a home address through their Bandai Namco ID from September 28, 2026.
details.why: Bandai is tightening event entry to stop resellers using extra accounts to win limited prizes and promos.

title: Robin Manga Rare
summary: OP-18 The Dominance of God brings a manga-style Nico Robin and Yoshitaka Amano Secret Rares; English release November 20.

facts: OP-18 The Dominance of God includes a manga-style Super Alt Art of Nico Robin, OP18-031, showing her pre-timeskip Enies Lobby look.
Artist Yoshitaka Amano drew the Secret Rare Saint Shamrock, OP18-119.
Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock make their card game debut in the set.
OP-18 releases in English on November 20, 2026, at $4.99 a pack.
details.why: Manga-style rares and Amano art are usually the most valuable pulls in a One Piece set.

title: 2.8 Billion Cards
summary: Disney Lorcana turns three with 2.8 billion cards sold and a Beauty and the Beast Curator's Collection.

facts: Disney Lorcana marked its third anniversary with 13 sets, more than 3,000 unique cards and 2.8 billion cards sold.
The Curator's Collection Beauty and the Beast Edition releases in October at select Disney locations, for the film's 35th anniversary.
Its six glimmers include Belle – Hidden Archer, Gaston – Intellectual Powerhouse, Beast – Tragic Hero, Lumiere and Mrs. Potts.
Collection Quests are coming to the Disney Cruise Line fleet in 2027.
details.why: Three years in, Lorcana is still growing fast, and its Disney-only collections give fans more to chase.

title: Delta Reign
summary: Mega Evolution: Delta Reign releases November 6 with Mega Rayquaza ex, after prereleases from October 24.

facts: Mega Evolution: Delta Reign releases November 6, with prereleases from October 24 and Pokémon TCG Live access from November 5.
It's the sixth Mega Evolution expansion, based on the Japanese set Storm Emeralda.
The set has 135+ cards: 4 Mega Pokémon ex, 6 Pokémon ex, 14 Illustration Rares, 17 Ultra Rares and 6 Special Illustration Rares.
Three Legendary Stadiums are made of six Stadium cards played in pairs.
It's Mega Rayquaza ex's first TCG appearance since Ancient Origins in 2015.
details.why: Mega Rayquaza is one of the most wanted Pokémon, so Delta Reign's top cards should be the season's biggest chase.

title: Banlist Shock
summary: Konami's list effective October 19 adds 34 Forbidden and 8 Limited cards, including Called by the Grave.

facts: Konami's new Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Forbidden & Limited List took effect October 19, revealed during YCS Houston (October 16-18).
It adds 34 newly Forbidden and 8 newly Limited cards.
Newly Forbidden cards include Amorphage Sloth, Amorphage Goliath, Aerial Eater, Albion the Branded Dragon, Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens and Called by the Grave.
Droll & Lock Bird and Perfectron Hydradrive Dragon are newly Limited.
Perfectron is the first OCG-only card Limited in the TCG since Sixth Sense in 2013.
details.why: Losing Called by the Grave and a long list of engine cards forces most competitive decks to rebuild.

title: Launch Day
summary: Riftbound Radiance (180 cards, nine new Champion Legends) and Disney Lorcana Hyperia City (204 cards, Coco's debut) both released October 23.

facts: Riftbound Radiance released October 23 with 180 cards, 66 of them Showcase.
It adds nine new Champion Legends, including Seraphine, Ekko, Ziggs, Jarvan IV and Evelynn, and the keywords Deploy, Show Off and Disarm.
It's the first Riftbound set released in English, French and Simplified Chinese at the same time; Showdown Decks cost $34.99, and the next set, Legacy, is due January 29, 2027.
Disney Lorcana Hyperia City, set 14, also released October 23 with 204 cards and the debut of Pixar's Coco, including Miguel and Héctor Rivera.
Hyperia City's Illumineer's Trove costs $49.99; the next Lorcana set, Into the Inkdark, is due February 12, 2027.
details.why: Two big sets on the same day means a crowded weekend for stores and a lot of new cards to sort through.

title: $600M Quarter
summary: Magic earned $616.1 million for Hasbro in Q3 2026, up 34% and its first quarter over $600 million.

facts: Hasbro reported on October 20 that Magic: The Gathering revenue reached $616.1 million in Q3 2026, up 34% from $459.4 million.
It's Magic's first quarter above $600 million.
Growth came from The Hobbit, already Magic's 4th bestselling set, and Reality Fracture.
Hasbro's total revenue rose 15% to $1.595 billion; it raised its outlook and doubled its buyback target to $400 million.
About $40 million of Reality Fracture sales moved from Q4 into Q3, and Hasbro expects Magic to be down in Q4.
details.why: Magic is now Hasbro's biggest growth engine, which keeps big licensed sets like The Hobbit and Star Trek coming.

title: Star Trek Timeline
summary: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek: prerelease Nov 6-12, MTG Arena Nov 10, tabletop Nov 13, card gallery Nov 30.

facts: Prerelease events run November 6-12, 2026.
The set comes to MTG Arena on November 10 and to tabletop stores on November 13.
MagicCon Atlanta and the 32nd Magic World Championship run November 13-15.
Magic Presents: To Boldly Go runs November 13 to January 28; Commander Party runs November 20-26 and January 15-21; the full card gallery lands November 30.
Prices include the Bundle at $69.99, Beam Me Up Bundle $99.99, Draft Night $119.99 and Scene Box $41.99.
details.why: These are the dates to know for preorders, prerelease seats and store events for the Star Trek set.

title: Release Radar
summary: Coming up: One Piece EB-05 Heroines Edition Vol. 2 (October), Riftbound Radiance and Lorcana Hyperia City (Oct 23), Pokémon Delta Reign (Nov 6), Magic Star Trek (Nov 13) and One Piece OP-18 (Nov 20).

facts: One Piece EB-05 Heroines Edition Vol. 2 arrives in English in October 2026 ($4.99 a pack) and in Japan on October 31.
Riftbound Radiance and Disney Lorcana Hyperia City both released October 23.
Pokémon's Mega Evolution: Delta Reign releases November 6, with prereleases from October 24.
Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek reaches stores November 13, after prereleases November 6-12 and MTG Arena on November 10.
One Piece OP-18 The Dominance of God releases in English on November 20 at $4.99 a pack.
details.why: Five major games release in about four weeks, so it's worth planning preorders and prerelease nights now.
